Package org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel

Enum Class CellPropertyType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CellPropertyType>
org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel.CellPropertyType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CellPropertyType>, Constable
public enum CellPropertyType extends Enum<CellPropertyType>
The CellPropertyType enum represents the different types of cell properties that can be applied to a cell. Each type is associated with a specific category CellPropertyCategory, which classifies and organizes the properties based on their characteristics.
Since:
5.4.0
